proposals.evidence: The older-brother expression has big/elder + brother. CDIAL 11225 vaḍra explicitly gives baṛā/baḍā/vaḍḍā big and elder usage; CDIAL 9661 gives bhrā/bharā and bhāi/bhāū brother. Ordered component-family edges preserve the complete phrase, including source labial, aspiration, rhotic and vowel notation. The vaḍra addenda discuss extraction from evaḍa-type size words rather than a simple vṛddha derivation; the component link preserves that uncertainty and does not assert a single ancient compound. Exact response: baṛa pra̤.

CDIAL 11225 supplies baṛā/baḍā/vaḍḍā with elder usage and feminine agreement; CDIAL 9349 gives bhēṇ/bhaiṇ, bahin/bahan and related regional sister forms.
